tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Jake leading Brent 90.7-53.6 is not a game, it is a corporate acquisition. EchoPoint is dismantling Obsidian tonight and the Ledger is going to have a lot to say about what that does to Brent's window talk heading into the stretch run.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: MITCHUM 93.3, SHAQ 76.5, AND I PICKED SHAQ. I PICKED SHAQ BECAUSE OF THE BUBBLE NARRATIVE AND THE EXCHANGE CLIMB AND NOW DEEPWATER IS OUT HERE PUTTING UP 93 POINTS AND MY LOCK RECORD IS 1-1 AND I HAVE NOTHING ELSE TO SAY ABOUT THIS GAME.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Called Jake over Brent, season record goes to 8-5 when this is official. Najee Harris gets cut, the backfield breathes, EchoPoint drops 90.7 points on a Sunday night. The sequence was not random — it was management.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Fronge is 33.4 against Charles right now and I took Charles as my lock. I took Charles. The lock record is 1-1 and the game is not over but I need everyone to understand I was correct the entire time and the early Fronge lead was a statistical anomaly that the market has already corrected.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Ryan at 76.4 against Corbishley right now, and before anyone comes to my mentions: I ranked him ninth. Down four. The receiving corps grade did not lie and a live score lead in week nine does not rewrite the structural argument I published on November fourth.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Season record 8-4, locks 2-0, and someone at this network needs to give me a full segment on the Mitchum-Shaq result tonight because two bubble teams at 10-6 and 8-8 just had a swing game and nobody is treating it like one. Deepwater at $101.05 is bleeding and Monarch climbed to $92.17 and one of these franchises is going to look back at this result in January.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Terrence is 5-7 on the season and I want everyone sitting with that number while he processes Wingard beating Adam 50.9-51.1 in a game that is currently separated by two tenths of a point. Two tenths. The Ledger will document every decimal.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: The Adam-Wingard game is 51.1-50.9 in Adam's favor right now and I picked Wingard and yes the season record is 5-7 but that lead is two tenths of a point and I am not conceding anything until the final whistle blows on a game this close.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Drew has 35.6 points on the board against Kevin. The team with zero wins all season has outscored the third-place franchise through most of this game. I had Kevin and my lock record is still 2-0 and Kevin is still going to close this out but Atlas putting up 35 against anyone is a footnote I did not expect to write tonight.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: ForgeHammer is in Havana with zero 2027 picks and 33.4 points against the number-one team in the league right now. I had Charles. Locks record 2-0, season 7-5, and I am completely unbothered by the current score because Crownline at $158.82 does not lose to a team with a Havana return address in week nine.
